name: Cape Town International Airport

slots.v: Coordinated airport by government designation. ATNS coordinates on weekdays, 08:00 to 16:00 local. The page does not say whether charter or private flights need slots.
slots.quote: O.R. Tambo International Airport, Cape Town International Airport and King Shaka International Airport have been designated by the Government as coordinated airports under the Airport Slot Coordination Regulations, 2012.

noise.v: No jet take-offs from a runway/taxiway intersection and no engine run-ups (except in an emergency) between 2000 and 0400; the page does not say whether these times are UTC or local.
noise.quote: No jet aircraft to use RWY/TWY intersection for take off between 2000 to 0400. No engine run-ups shall be allowed between 2000 to 0400, unless in an emergency.

permits.v: Foreign (non-South African) carriers need a Foreign Operator Permit for scheduled or non-scheduled commercial international services. Class IV services with up to 8 passengers or 1,000 kg, and no carriage within South Africa, are exempt from the permit but need special permission from the National Department of Transport before filing a flight plan. National rule; no notice period on the page
permits.quote: All non- South African air carriers that wish to undertake scheduled or non scheduled commercial international air services
